name: True Dread Files
sub_niche: true scary stories & unexplained real cases
brand_voice: A calm narrator recalling something that happened to them — 'I still remember that summer' — in their own voice. The account is never claimed as true and never admitted as invention. Mundane relatable settings that slowly go wrong. No analysis, no neat resolution.
hook_format: Open cold in first person, either one chilling line from the scariest moment then pull back, or the ordinary detail that will curdle — e.g. 'I only stopped taking the county road after what kept pace with my car.' NEVER frame it as a file/report/case or say 'the police report says'.

pain_points: generic AI horror slop with fake-looking art
channels that oversell and underdeliver on 'true' stories
wanting long ambient horror to fall asleep to
content_triggers: allegedly true encounters with consistent mundane details and physical geography
liminal real places: night shifts, empty roads, basements
under-confirmed danger that could plausibly happen to an ordinary person
engagement_drivers: video DESCRIPTION only (never spoken in-narration): invite viewers to share their own encounter
video DESCRIPTION only: tease the next episode's setting

image_style_prompt: ONE single full-frame REAL PHOTOGRAPH, amateur night photo on an old phone camera, harsh single light or sodium glow, heavy high-ISO grain, slight motion blur, imperfect off-center framing, mundane real environment. If any figure appears it is DISTANT, PARTIAL, or a SILHOUETTE in shadow — a shape, never a close face; suggested not shown. Empty liminal spaces and absence are preferred. no text, no words
image_style_negative: illustration, painting, digital art, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, symmetrical, movie poster, studio lighting, posed, bright cheerful colors, close-up face, facial close up, distorted face, deformed face, disfigured, melted features, mangled, mutilated, gore, blood, wound, corpse, monster, creature, fangs, claws, zombie, demon, low detail, watermark
image_style_lock: as a real unedited amateur photograph, grainy and imperfect; any person is distant or a silhouette, never a distorted close-up face
description_disclaimer: Stories in this video are dramatized first-person horror inspired by real-world situations. Names, places, and events are fictionalized.
